description: This file is a service layer class (NoteService) in a Java Spring application responsible for managing notes, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service layer class managing note operations such as create, read, update, delete.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes, sorted by id ascending.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its id or throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note from a NoteRequest object.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by id with data from a NoteRequest.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its id, throws an exception if not found.
